title: export: Mermaid + DOT + SVG emitters + architecture report
description:
[v2 plan: docs/v2-plan.md · WBS: docs/agent-team/V2-WBS.md · wave W4]
Seats: PROD-01, PROD-02, PROD-03, PROD-04
crates/gui/src/export/{mermaid,dot,svg,report}.rs: text emitters for call graph, CFG, types, modules and (where sensible) flow trace; hand-rolled SVG (no new crate) for the same; report.rs builds a Markdown 'architecture report' (overview metrics, module map, hotspots/complexity table, refs summary, diagrams as embedded Mermaid fenced blocks). Extend the Export menu with these targets writing to a chosen path. Owner: crates/gui/src/export/*. Verify: cargo build/clippy/test -p repowalk-gui; unit tests assert Mermaid and DOT output for a fixed fixture graph is byte-stable and valid (balanced fences, unique node ids).

EVIDENCE (PROD-01..04 / TL-PROD, batch B2):
Implemented all four emitters as pure functions in crates/core/src/export/ (data in, text out: no file I/O, no clock, no absolute paths). New shared backend-neutral graph model in export/util.rs (private mod) makes ordering/dedup/cap decisions once for Mermaid+DOT+SVG.
Files: crates/core/src/export/mermaid.rs, dot.rs, svg.rs, report.rs (all four stubs filled), crates/core/src/export/util.rs (new, private helper), crates/core/src/export/mod.rs (+`mod util;` only; public API/enum untouched), crates/core/tests/export_emitters.rs (new, 10 tests, hand-built Index+Analysis, no fixture parsing).
Mermaid: flowchart LR call graph over EdgeKind::Call (real names via Index::symbols lookup, sanitized+hashed unique ids, dashed -.-> for NameOnly/Ambiguous/Unresolved, top-150-by-degree cap noted in a %% comment); flowchart TD CFG from analysis.cfgs (diamond Branch/Loop, hexagon Match, labels+line, edge labels true/false/back, one-node placeholder when no CFG); classDiagram for analysis.types/type_edges (fields+methods, Inherit <|-- , Impl ..|> , Field *-- , dangling endpoints dropped); flowchart LR module graph from analysis.modules/module_edges with import counts on labels.
DOT: digraph repowalk { ... } for the same four, rankdir LR/TB/BT/LR, sanitized ids, quoted+escaped labels, confidence/dashed via style=dashed, arrowhead normal/onormal/diamond.
SVG: hand-rolled standalone SVG (no crate), longest-path layered layout, rounded rect/diamond/hexagon + escaped <text>, <line> edges with arrow <marker>s, one <style> block using the app dark palette (#0F1115/#14161B/#343B47/#E6E9EF/#8A93A3/#4C8DFF), title + caption; >400 nodes -> top-degree subgraph with a <text> caption.
Report: Markdown with empty-state-safe sections, no absolute paths (repo root reduced to its basename) and no timestamp.

  cargo clippy -p repowalk-core --all-targets -- -D warnings -> Finished, exit 0
  cargo test -p repowalk-core                        -> 115 lib + 10 export_emitters + 6 contract + 4 grammar_abi + 2 walk_metrics + golden/analysis_golden: all passed, 0 failed (TEST=0)
  deterministic: emitters_are_byte_stable calls each Mermaid/DOT/SVG/report twice and asserts identical strings.

CLI/GUI API (handoff to PROD-05, re PROD-3):
  repowalk_core::export::mermaid(&Index, &Analysis, &Diagram) -> String  (body only)
  repowalk_core::export::dot(&Index, &Analysis, &Diagram) -> String
  repowalk_core::export::svg(&Index, &Analysis, &Diagram) -> String
  repowalk_core::export::markdown_report(&Index, &Analysis) -> String
  repowalk_core::export::Diagram { CallGraph, Cfg { symbol: String }, Types, Modules }

Degraded because a dependency stub was empty: complexity.rs (CORE-4) hotspots/per_file/unused_variables and modules.rs/types.rs still return empty. The report detects the CORE-4 stub (per_file empty while analysis.cfgs non-empty), prints "Complexity aggregates unavailable (dependency stub)" and derives the tables from the raw Analysis::cfgs; unused-count falls back to the documented reads==0 predicate; the Modules/Types diagrams read analysis.modules/type_edges directly so they render real data as soon as the analyzers populate the artifact. No fallback masks a real empty result.
